abilities.name: Ogre Rage
abilities.text:
Activate to increase Gall's damage by 25%, but reduce Cho's Armor by 25.

Passive: Gall is permanently immune to Stun and Silence effects.

abilities.name: Shadowflame
abilities.text: Deal 135 damage to enemies in the area.

abilities.name: Dread Orb
abilities.text: Throw a bomb that will bounce three times, dealing 126 damage to enemies.

abilities.name: Runic Blast
abilities.text: Detonate Cho's Rune Bomb, dealing 210 damage around it.

abilities.name: Twisting Nether
abilities.text: After 1 second, nearby enemies are Slowed by 50% while Gall channels, up to 5 seconds. Activate to deal 353 damage.

abilities.name: Shadow Bolt Volley
abilities.text: After 1 second, unleash 20 Shadow Bolts over 4 seconds, each dealing 87 damage to the first target hit. The bolts fire towards your mouse.

1.name: Keep Moving!
1.text: Increases the Movement Speed bonus of Shove by 10% and its duration by 2 seconds.

1.name: Taskmaster
1.text: Every time Cho is hit by a Hero Basic Attack, reduce the cooldown of Shove by 1 second.

1.name: We See You!
1.text: Eye of Kilrogg's cooldown is decreased by 25 seconds, its range is increased by 33%, and the number of Basic Attacks required to kill it is increased by 1.

4.name: Rising Dread
4.text: Each bounce of Dread Orb increases its radius by 20% and damage by 15%. Activate Dread Orb before the second bounce ends to reverse the direction of the third bounce.

4.name: Runic Persistence
4.text: Runic Blast deals an additional 180 damage over 3 seconds in an area around the detonation point.

4.name: Bomb's Away
4.text:
Quest: Damaging a Hero with Runic Blast increases its damage by 4.

Reward: After damaging 20 Heroes, the range and speed of Cho's Rune Bomb is increased by 20%.

7.name: Edge of Madness
7.text: Every subsequent hit of Shadowflame against the same enemy Hero deals an additional 12% damage, to a maximum of 60%. These bonuses are lost if the Hero has not been hit for 7 seconds.

7.name: Double Trouble
7.text:
Quest: If Shadowflame hits an enemy Hero that is afflicted by Cho's Consuming Blaze, its cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds.

Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, Shadowflame's cooldown is instead permanently reduced by 1 second.

7.name: Ogre Rampage
7.text: Increase the damage bonus of Ogre Rage by 5%. Each time Gall damages an enemy Hero while Ogre Rage is active, this bonus increases by 1% for 4 seconds, up to an additional 10% bonus damage.

10.name: Shadow Bolt Volley
10.text: After 1 second, unleash 20 Shadow Bolts over 4 seconds, each dealing 87 damage to the first target hit. The bolts fire towards your mouse.

10.name: Twisting Nether
10.text: After 1 second, nearby enemies are Slowed by 50% while Gall channels, up to 5 seconds. Activate to deal 353 damage.

13.name: Searing Shadows
13.text: Enemy Heroes hit by Shadowflame take an additional 2% of their maximum Health as damage.

13.name: Psychotic Break
13.text: Increase Gall's damage to enemy Heroes by 10%. Upon dying, Gall gains Ogre Rage and can use Abilities for 10 seconds.

13.name: Twilight Nova
13.text: After the first bounce of Dread Orb, 2 extra bombs bounce to the sides once.

16.name: Leaden Orb
16.text: Dread Orb Stuns enemy Heroes for 0.6 seconds.

16.name: Deafening Blast
16.text: Runic Blast Silences enemy Heroes for 1.25 seconds.

16.name: Shadowsnare
16.text: Enemy Heroes hit by your Basic Abilities are Slowed by 15% for 4 seconds. This effect can stack up to 2 times.

20.name: Shadowfury
20.text: Shadow Bolt Volley hits all enemies in its path.

20.name: Shifting Nether
20.text: Twisting Nether now teleports Cho to a targeted location before it begins Channeling.

20.name: The Will of Gall
20.text: Takedowns permanently increase the bonus of Ogre Rage by 2%.

20.name: Twilight Frenzy
20.text: Activate to reduce the cooldowns of Shadowflame and Dread Orb to 2 seconds for the next 6 seconds.
